name: Kawakami Otojirou
source:
Occupation: Actor and chairman.

A young man who aspires to make his living as an actor.
He is the leader of the Kawakami theatrical troupe. In a secret side job, he dresses in women’s clothing and works as a geisha to earn money for the theater company's expenses.
He is a personable and caring big brother figure.
